tools.name: update_template
tools.description: Update or create a POML template. Strictly renders a temporary file before replacing the destination; validation failure leaves existing content unchanged. Requires Node and POML_CLI.

name.description: Template name without .poml, e.g. tasks/custom. Use letters, numbers, underscores, hyphens and / separators; no absolute paths or traversal.

context.description: Optional complete JSON context for validation; omitted uses synthetic system variables, never saved user data.
